objective: Xác định categories/variable cho một simple data question, classify observations đã ghi nhận và tổ chức counts vào tally/frequency table có total kiểm tra được.
misconceptions_or_representation_notes: Categories must cover the observations being counted without unintended overlap.
Data question and coding choices affect what can be concluded.
change_reason: Removed unsupported data-collection action; claims directly support framing/classification/table organization of recorded observations.

objective: Đọc line/time graphs và pie charts bằng axes/scales/legends, tính part-to-whole proportions khi phù hợp và mô tả patterns mà không biến display thành causal claim.

external_curriculum_mappings.phase: KS2-KS3 line graphs/pie charts and interpretation

misconceptions_or_representation_notes: Connected points do not automatically imply observed continuous motion.
A pie chart requires categories to be parts of one whole.
change_reason: Added accepted relative-frequency support for part-to-whole proportion calculation.

objective: Trong simple finite chance models, dùng impossible/possible/certain và more/less/equally likely đúng theo model, rồi liên hệ các comparisons với probability scale 0-to-1.
misconceptions_or_representation_notes: Chance language depends on the modeled outcomes.
Continuous probability later requires care because nonempty events may have probability 0.
Equal probabilities do not mean identical events.
change_reason: Restricted informal chance-language claim to finite positive-mass models where direct mathematical support exists.

objective: Enumerate outcomes của simple finite experiments, kiểm tra sample space exhaustive và dùng favorable/total counting chỉ khi elementary outcomes được justified là equally likely.
misconceptions_or_representation_notes: Counting outcomes is not enough unless those outcomes are equally likely.
A sample space must be exhaustive for the model used.

objective: Ghi nhận/read repeated simple chance experiments, tính empirical relative frequency và giải thích vì sao finite runs có thể cho frequencies khác nhau.
misconceptions_or_representation_notes: A finite relative frequency is observed data, not exact theoretical probability.
Small samples can vary substantially under a nondegenerate model.
change_reason: Added direct finite-run variation support using the Bernoulli/Binomial model.
